evidence.claim: TAL-15, the push notification service, blocks TAL-56 and is still in Backlog.
TAL-16, the Apple developer account and push certificate, blocks TAL-15 and is still open. This holds up TAL-56 indirectly.
TAL-31 is a Slack notification for paid invoices and is already Done. It overlaps only in part, so it is not a duplicate.

body.why: TAL-56 is Blocked because TAL-15 (Push notification service) is still in Backlog, and TAL-15 is itself waiting on TAL-16 (Apple developer account for push certificates), which is also open. The issue has a clear description and acceptance criteria, so the blockers are the only problem.
wouldChange: TAL-15 is done, which needs TAL-16 done first.
The link from TAL-15 to TAL-56 is removed, for example if push delivery is built inside TAL-56.

check.reason: Verdict and accepted outcome both verify.
